2738786.title: Seoul World Cities Culture Festival
2738786.overview: The 30th anniversary of Seoul's global-culture festival at DDP: embassy zones from dozens of countries, world performance stages and busking, world food and dessert zones, traditional costume and games, and international photo exhibitions.

2818501.title: Donghak Peasant Revolution Commemoration
2818501.overview: The national ceremony for the 1894 Donghak Peasant Revolution — the popular uprising against feudal corruption and foreign encroachment — held on the anniversary of its first victory at Hwangtohyeon, at the National Museum of Korea.
2818501.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

3495688.title: Fishing Village Life & Tourism Fair
3495688.overview: Fishing villages from around Korea set up on Gwanghwamun Square: village booths, specialties, and hands-on programs presenting coastal life — with evening wave-and-sea healing lounges — for city dwellers imagining a life by the sea.

2601364.title: Suragan Royal Dining Experience
2601364.overview: Dine where the palace cooked: an evening in Gyeongbokgung's Sojubang kitchen quarter tasting royal cuisine with court performances and games, attended by costumed court staff — see, taste, watch, feel, as the name promises. 30,000 won, reservation required.

2560317.title: Forest Food Festival
2560317.overview: The Korea Forest Service brings the country's forest products to Gwanghwamun: mushrooms, nuts, wild greens, and regional specialties to taste and buy, with performances and hands-on programs on the square.

2816651.title: Seongju Chamoe Melon & Life Culture Festival
2816651.overview: Seongju grows most of Korea's chamoe (the yellow oriental melon), and its festival in the ancient Seongbak Forest — beside the royal placenta shrine of King Sejong's princes — pairs melon tastings, auctions, and lounges with life-themed walks under 500-year-old willows.

2841074.title: Global Yeongdo Coffee Festival
2841074.overview: Busan's Yeongdo island — an emerging coffee destination anchored by harbor-warehouse roasteries — hosts a coffee-industry festival: specialty tastings, roasting demos, barista performances, and pop-ups against the shipyard seascape.

2374957.title: When Roses Feel (Rose Festival)
2374957.overview: Fourteen thousand roses of 120 varieties bloom at Igok Rose Park in Daegu for a fantasy-themed spring festival — 'a day in the rose kingdom' — with art programs and evening openings among the beds.
2374957.hours: Varies by day (evenings on opening day)

4056597.title: King Sejong's 629th Birthday
4056597.overview: Sejong City celebrates its namesake king's birthday with a book fair, talk concerts, performances, and Hangeul education programs at Central Park — linked to the Sejong falling-fire festival the next evening.

3016781.title: Millennium Naju Eupseong Culture Festival
3016781.overview: Naju — 'the Hanyang of Honam', a former provincial capital of a thousand years — stages madang plays, gate-guard ceremonies, and heritage programs around Geumseonggwan hall and the old town walls.

4064297.title: Flower Gazing + Water Gazing Book Spot
4064297.overview: An open-air library series in Gongju's old royal quarter: reading lounges by the Jemincheon stream (a Local 100 culture spot), author talks, poetry readings, night performances, and archive photo exhibitions of the neighborhood's past.
4064297.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

3300114.title: Sejong Nakhwa Falling Fire Festival
3300114.overview: Sejong's designated intangible heritage brought to a lake park: nakhwa — charcoal-filled mulberry-paper wicks strung between poles — burn and shed embers like falling petals over the water, an old rite against misfortune reborn as one of Korea's most photogenic night spectacles. Free.
3300114.place: Sejong Lake Park and Central Park

3115722.title: Jakdang Festa
3115722.overview: Busan's youth-culture space Jakdangso marks its sixth year with a maker festival: a youth creators' market and live stages outdoors, participatory exhibitions in the BNK gallery, and creator workshops upstairs.

3116057.title: Central Asia Spring Festival
3116057.overview: The cultures of Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, and Tajikistan fill Seoul Plaza: yurt experiences, 20 culture booths, traditional performances, food tastings, crafts, and costume try-ons over a spring weekend.

577335.title: Suwon Theatre Festival
577335.overview: Running since 1996 and now centered on 'theater in public space': street theater, circus, and site-specific performance turn the leafy Sangsang Campus into a forest party each May — free, outdoors, and family-friendly.

1717921.title: D.FESTA Street Performance Festival
1717921.overview: Daehangno's street-arts festival turns 20: two days of performances filling Marronnier Park and the surrounding theater district, taking art out of the black boxes and onto the street where Korea's small-theater culture lives.

2602974.title: Wonju Yongsugol Poppy Festival
2602974.overview: Korea's only village-run ('ri'-level) flower festival: what began as one returning farmer's 300-pyeong poppy patch in 2005 now covers 13,000 pyeong with poppies and 43 companion blooms in a Wonju valley — a 'star village' pick among Korea's 1,200 rural communities.

1253973.title: Ulsan Grand Park Rose Festival
1253973.overview: Three million roses in Korea's finest rose garden: Ulsan Grand Park's 18th rose festival pairs the massed blooms with performances, citizen programs, and night lighting that turns the garden luminous after dark.

141251.title: Geumsa Chamoe Melon Festival
141251.overview: The capital region's only chamoe-growing town celebrates its 20th melon harvest by the Namhangang: melon-picking, surprise auctions, family programs, and a youth music festival at Geumsa Park in Yeoju.

4065912.title: Gangneung Bread Festa
4065912.overview: Gangneung's bakeries and dessert makers gather in the courtyards of the old Daedohobu government office: pop-up, experience, and event zones with local favorites, tastings, and prize draws — the coffee city proves it can bake too.

557329.title: Danyang Sobaeksan Royal Azalea Festival
557329.overview: Royal azaleas crown Sobaeksan's ridgelines in late May, and Danyang celebrates below with a mountain-spirit rite, riverside stages, busking, and food streets — pairing summit hikes through the pink fields with the town's famous garlic dishes.

3097834.title: 14th Diaspora Film Festival
3097834.overview: A film festival on migration and coexistence in Incheon — the port where Korea's first emigrant ship sailed for Hawaii in 1902: international films on diaspora themes, talks, and programs at the Incheon Art Platform. Free.

4058500.title: ING Festival
4058500.overview: A family ESG festival at Understand Avenue in Seongsu: children's art contests, values markets, and a retro 'romance festival' of 90s–00s playground games, stationery shops, and snack stalls bridging parents' nostalgia and kids' discovery.

3110383.title: Goesan Red Taste Festival
3110383.overview: Goesan built a festival on one color: the red of its famous gochu peppers and early-summer blooms. Spicy-food challenges, red-themed events, and flower fields at the organic expo plaza — with festival-linked discounts at local attractions and markets.

1632810.title: Yeongju Sobaeksan Royal Azalea Festival
1632810.overview: The Yeongju side of Sobaeksan's azalea season: guided ridge treks through the pink colonies with ecology interpreters, plus food and farm markets at the Punggi ginseng pop-up park below — the mountain's sweeping views doing the heavy lifting.

2818494.title: Busan Family Festival
2818494.overview: Family Month at Busan Citizens Park: the 20th edition runs 40 family-play booths, caricature and counseling corners, exhibitions, and the 'language of family' video contest — a gentle, free day out for households of every shape.

4064543.title: Hangang Love Children's Drawing Contest
4064543.overview: The 23rd riverside drawing contest for kindergarteners and elementary kids by the Han River authorities — art on the river's ecology, with performances and hands-on programs at the Ttukseom waterside stage.

1834279.title: Radiant Seogwipo (Hayeong)
1834279.overview: Seogwipo strings day into night: an olle-trail city walk by day, a seaside music festival at dusk, and a drone light show over Jaguri Park after dark — the southern city's coast as one continuous evening.

1804113.title: Korea Youth Expo
1804113.overview: The national youth expo at Yeosu Expo: some 300 booths on AI, digital, and renewable-energy careers, 20-plus participation programs, a youth talent stage, and a water-boom festival for teens from across the country.
1804113.sponsor: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family · Jeollanam-do

749800.title: Janghang Port Kkolgap Seafood Festival
749800.overview: A fishermen's-association festival at Janghang Port on the Geum River estuary: fresh sashimi and dried seafood at co-op prices, tastings, and a waterside raw-fish cafe — pair it with the Sinseong-ri reed fields and the old smelter chimney nearby.

2823481.title: Asan Oeam Village Night Tour
2823481.overview: The 500-year-old folk village of Oeam — stone walls, thatched roofs, and noble houses still lived in — opens after dark: lantern-lit lanes, performances, and heritage programs recreating the romance of a Joseon night stroll.

1810345.title: Ansan Seongho Culture Festival
1810345.overview: A festival for Yi Ik (Seongho), the great Silhak pragmatist philosopher who spent his life in what is now Ansan: a Confucian memorial rite at his shrine, local folk performances, silhak-themed experiences, a golden-bell quiz, and museum lectures.

2393544.title: Jeonju Heritage Night Tour
2393544.overview: 'A night stroll through a thousand-year capital': Jeonju's hanok village, Gyeonggijeon shrine, the Confucian school, Pungnammun gate, and the restored provincial office light up for two June nights of performances, tours, and experiences led by eight themed 'masters'.
2393544.place: Jeonju Hanok Village and heritage sites

3114311.title: Easygoing Hangang Triathlon Festival
3114311.overview: A triathlon with no rankings and no clock: swim, cycle, and run the Han River at your own pace over three days at Ttukseom — 30,000 participants and 660,000 visitors made it Seoul's feel-good sports festival. Entry 30,000 won per event.

1835137.title: Gochang Getbol Mudflat Festival
1835137.overview: Walk the UNESCO World Natural Heritage mudflats at Mandol: barefoot tidal-flat ecology programs, daily performances, and discounted local seafood — including free tastings of Gochang's famous pungcheon eel.

3386681.title: Iksan Modern History Culture Festival
3386681.overview: 'Walking through Iksan's time': the arts street and Somni modern-history quarter stage the years from 1910s opening to liberation — era theme songs and busking, land-registry mission tours, colonial-era costume experiences, and independence-movement performances.

2001015.title: Seongbuk World Food Festival Nurimasil
2001015.overview: Seongbuk-ro becomes a world food street for the 18th Nurimasil: national dishes and embassy booths from dozens of countries, a coexistence-themed parade, world culture experiences, and stages — Seoul's neighborhood take on the global table.

4063951.title: Bangaun Festival (Dog Walking & Giving)
4063951.overview: A dog-and-owner festival at Ansan Lake Park where exercise meets charity: a walking event, pet-etiquette games, health counseling, experience zones, and gift packages for every participating pair.

2818857.title: Organic Day
2818857.overview: Korea's organic-farming day (June 2 — a pun on 'yugi-nong') celebrated at Cheonggye Plaza: eco-food events, a certified-organic market, webtoon contest exhibitions, and consumer programs on climate-friendly eating.

2807078.title: Korea Buddhist Culture Expo
2807078.overview: A Buddhist-culture trade fair at EXCO Daegu across nine genres — temple food (the 'urban temple kitchen' special), architecture, craft, art, ritual, tea — spanning traditional philosophy to contemporary art in the heartland of Silla Buddhism.

1118680.title: Korea Wine Festival
1118680.overview: Korea's biggest wine festival in Yeongdong — the country's largest grape and wine county: local winery tastings, food pairings, parades, and wine-making exhibitions along the Yeongdong stream. The place to survey how far Korean wine has come.

2853719.title: Gunsan Craft Beer & Blues Festival
2853719.overview: Korea's only truly local craft-beer festival: four Gunsan breweries pouring beer brewed from 100% Gunsan-grown barley malt, 16 blues bands from home and abroad, and 30 of the food-famous city's best restaurants at the modern-history museum lot. Entry 6,000 won with 5,000 back in local vouchers.

4070513.title: Firefly & Insect Festival
4070513.overview: An ecology festival at the Chungbuk agricultural research institute: nighttime firefly watching, insect exhibitions and hands-on programs, and family ecology education — one of the accessible places to see fireflies near Cheongju.

4069856.title: Seocho Classic Theme Park
4069856.overview: A neighborhood park in Bangbae becomes a classical-music theme park: open-air concerts, music workshops, an art-salon flea market, water play set to classical scores, and picnic zones — classical without the concert-hall formality.

2488259.title: Jeodo Giant Octopus Festival
2488259.overview: The fishing families of Daejin Port — Korea's northernmost East Sea harbor — cook their own giant Pacific octopus catch: blanched slices, spicy salads, and harbor-side feasting where the daemuneo actually lands.

2812160.title: Camping Cooking Festival
2812160.overview: A three-day stay-in camping cook-off at Imjingak's Peace Nuri campground, now in its 10th year: teams cook competition menus at their campsites for a judged final, with regional-food booths, performances, and family programs around the grounds.

3489648.title: Hoengseong Lake Trail Festival
3489648.overview: A 'festival of rest' on section 5 of the Hoengseong Lake trail: 9km of quiet waterside walking with three viewpoints and small installations, plus stalls of local hangwa sweets and fresh produce from the valley farms.

1327778.title: Geoje Okpo Great Victory Festival
1327778.overview: Commemorating Admiral Yi's first naval victory of the Imjin War (Okpo, 1592): memorial rites, a victory procession with navy band and honor guard, water-gun battles, drone light shows, and a musical staged with real ships and fireworks on Okpo bay.

2495286.title: Sokcho Silhyangmin (Displaced People) Culture Festival
2495286.overview: Korea's only festival of displaced-family culture, in the city where war refugees from the North built Abai Village: performances, exhibitions, and food carrying the memory of separation into its third and fourth generations — Sokcho's most distinctive story, told by those who live it.

530450.title: Goyang Haengju Culture Festival
530450.overview: Commemorating the Battle of Haengju (1593) — one of the Imjin War's three great victories, won with civilians hurling stones beside General Gwon Yul's troops: a national stone-throwing (bak-bursting) contest, drone and fireworks shows over the Han, and the Haengju musical at the fortress where it happened.

4070242.title: Le Mouton Walking Club in Suncheon
4070242.overview: A 1,400-person branded walking event through Suncheon Bay National Garden: a morning walk from Green Island to the workation center, finished with a garden concert — walking-shoe culture meets Korea's most famous garden city. Entry 10,000 won.

3304231.title: Mureung Byeoryucheonji Lavender Festival
3304231.overview: A limestone quarry turned wonderland: Mureung Byeoryucheonji's emerald lakes and gardens host June lavender fields with day and night programs, illuminated evenings, lavender foods, and city goods — one of Gangwon's most surreal landscapes.

3300182.title: Yangpyeong Wheat Festival
3300182.overview: Golden wheat fields at Gahyeon-ri host Yangpyeong's eco-minded wheat festival: field photo spots at peak gold, a Korean-wheat food market, wheat-and-sool classes, and environment-first operations.

2870717.title: Jeungpyeong Jangttul Field Song Festival
2870717.overview: The 20th festival of Jangttul dure nongyo — Jeungpyeong's designated communal farming songs: field-song demonstrations, farming and traditional-food experiences, kids' ssireum contests, and folk performances at the folklore museum.

4070216.title: Global Creator Art Fair
4070216.overview: An international creator fair on the plaza by Hongdae's exit 8: busking stages, markets, and content showcases connecting Korean and international creators in Seoul's indie-culture heartland. Free.

4069159.title: Stay Night: Yeongdeok Starlight Walk
4069159.overview: A family night event on Yeongdeok's sunrise coast: azalea planting, a starlight night trek along the shore, snow-crab games, and kids' programs under one of the east coast's clearest night skies.

3498398.title: Forced Mobilization Memorial Gathering
3498398.overview: A remembrance event for victims of wartime forced mobilization and their families: a stamp walking tour through Gwanghwamun's colonial-era historic sites from Cheonggye Plaza, with quizzes, performances, and booths open to all.
3498398.sponsor: Foundation for Victims of Forced Mobilization

2988364.title: Mudeungsan Humanities Festival
2988364.overview: A thinking-person's festival at Mudeungsan National Park's Jeungsimsa district: lectures, performances, and quiet programs built on the mountain's name — 'without rank' — inviting visitors to switch off the noise and build a thought of their own.

3305155.title: Sejong Dano Festival
3305155.overview: Dano — the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, once one of Korea's great holidays — revived at Sejong Lake Park: hair-washing in iris water, rice-cake pounding, 15 craft benches, ssireum wrestling for adults and kids, and holiday foods.

1248817.title: Gimje Moaksan Music Festival
1248817.overview: A healing music festival on the lawn before Geumsansa — the great Baekje-founded temple under Moaksan: multi-genre outdoor stages, barefoot red-clay path walks, kids' programs, and Gimje farm-food booths in the green of early summer.
